name: Guerra and Others v Italy (Enichem Manfredonia)

jurisdiction.court: European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) – Grand Chamber

description: Application no. 14967/89 by 40 residents of Manfredonia (FG) who lived about 1 km from the Enichem agricoltura chemical plant (production of fertilisers and caprolactam), classified as “high risk” under the Seveso Directive. Alleged emissions of flammable and toxic substances, a serious accident in 1976 and the lack of information on the risks and on emergency plans.
outcome: Violation of Article 8 ECHR. The Court, sitting as a Grand Chamber, held that the State had a positive obligation to provide residents with essential information on environmental and health risks and on the conduct to adopt in the event of an accident; the failure to do so had prevented them from assessing the risks to themselves and their families. Leading case on the duty of environmental information under the Convention.
